reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and adds a shared isHoliday, and the new handler reuses RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule, but the daily skip is never put behind a shared function and is re-expressed at every consumer.

duplication.why: The daily weekend/holiday skip predicate (daily && skipWeekend && (isWeekend || isHoliday)) is written in getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and twice inside getNextDate (forward and reverse lookups repeat the same find block).

placement.why: Holiday matching and moving are in shared/schedules.ts where weekend logic lives, but the daily-skip rule is spread between shared getNextDate and two server handlers.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (rule, range handler, holidays, MM-DD entries).

maintainability.why: Four inline copies of the daily-skip predicate must stay in sync, schedule-template.ts still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays or daily skip, and lookahead sizes (holidays.length + 8, holidays.length + 2) are ad-hoc per site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and getNextDate each test weekend/holiday for daily schedules themselves instead of through one shared skip function; budget/schedule-template.ts calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays

disguised_duplication.where: the same daily skip appears as a .filter in getUpcomingDates, a map-to-null in getDatesInRange and .find blocks in getNextDate

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; daily-schedule special cases in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange re-implement the skip; the two schedule-template.ts call sites ignore holidays and the daily rule
